key_insight: AlphaGRPO applies Group Relative Policy Optimization with a decompositional, verifiable reward to AR‑Diffusion Unified Multimodal Models, unlocking intrinsic self‑reflective reasoning and iterative multimodal generation without an extra cold‑start stage.
problem_solved: Enables UMMs to infer implicit user intent and autonomously diagnose-and-correct generated outputs—addressing poor reasoning, limited editability, and reliance on costly cold‑start or separate RL fine‑tuning workflows.
method: Integrate Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) into AR‑Diffusion UMMs to optimize generation policies across modalities.
Design a decompositional verifiable reward that splits global objectives into checkable sub‑rewards (e.g., intent alignment, fidelity, consistency) used to supervise policy updates.

Close a self‑reflective refinement loop: generate → verify/diagnose via decomposed rewards → propose corrective edits → update policy iteratively, enabling reasoning Text→Image generation and autonomous refinement.
impact: Delivers more reliable, sample‑efficient multimodal generation that infers intent and self‑corrects without extra cold‑start training. Practitioners gain stronger reasoning and editing capabilities from unified models with lower training overhead.

paper_title: AlphaGRPO: Unlocking Self-Reflective Multimodal Generation in UMMs via Decompositional Verifiable Reward
paper_authors: Runhui Huang, Jie Wu, Rui Yang, Zhe Liu, Hengshuang Zhao
